name: Lateral Lunge with Pause

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: NASM Frontal Plane Functional Movement Training

steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands clasped comfortably in front of your chest.
Take a wide step to your right, keeping both feet pointed straight ahead.
Hinge your hips back and bend your right knee, lowering into a side lunge while keeping your left leg completely straight.
Pause at the bottom of the lunge for two full seconds, feeling a deep stretch along the inside of your straight left leg.
Push strongly off your right foot to return to the center standing position, then repeat to the left.
coaching_cues: Keep the heel of your lunging foot firmly planted on the floor throughout.
Send your hips backward as if sitting into a chair behind your lunging leg.
Maintain an upright chest and open posture.

sources.attribution: NASM Corrective Exercise Frontal Plane Guide
